summary: Stripe assessment payment hardening: per-community online payment / receipt email / dispute auto-reversal switches (all OFF) and cached connected-account state on communities; one in-flight assessment checkout per lot and owner tenure; stripe_payouts and payment_receipts tables. No existing row changes.

preflight.name: no lot/tenure has more than one in-flight assessment checkout
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT property_id, tenure_id FROM payments WHERE product_type = 'assessment_payment' AND fee_type = 'assessment' AND payment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND settlement_state IN ('awaiting_payment', 'processing') GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING count(*) > 1) d

preflight.name: the switch column does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'communities' AND column_name = 'online_payments_enabled'

preflight.name: the payout and receipt tables do not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('stripe_payouts', 'payment_receipts')

expected_changes: communities: nine columns added (online_payments_enabled, payment_receipt_emails_enabled, stripe_dispute_auto_reversal default false; change audit and cached Stripe account state). No community is switched on.
payments: unique partial index uq_payments_assessment_in_flight (one awaiting/processing assessment checkout per lot + tenure).
stripe_payouts and payment_receipts created empty, service_role only.

verify.name: no community has online payments switched on
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE online_payments_enabled

verify.name: no community emails receipts
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE payment_receipt_emails_enabled

verify.name: no community auto-reverses disputes
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE stripe_dispute_auto_reversal

verify.name: the in-flight index exists and is unique
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_payments_assessment_in_flight' AND indexdef LIKE 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX%'

verify.name: new tables are empty
verify.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM stripe_payouts) + (SELECT count(*) FROM payment_receipts))::int
